In a post on the social media platform

, Merritt took a quote from The Joe Rogan Experience podcast episode #2556. “I have a Tesla. I love it. But there’s also [the] reality of brake dust. It’s way more brake dust with those things,” Rogan said on the podcast.

Merritt disagreed with Rogan’s take, saying that EVs did not emit more brake dust “because you rarely need to use your brakes in the first place,” he said. The influencer added that the regenerative braking technology enables drivers to use “one-pedal driving” and that brakes “actually last longer on EVs” due to one-pedal driving.

Notably, regenerative braking does not physically use the brakes on a vehicle. Instead, the electric motor is essentially run in reverse when the driver takes their foot off the pedal as a way to recapture energy that could be lost in the form of heat when applying brakes.
